Auto Industry Performance of October-2026

  • 13/11/2026
  • New Delhi

Monthly Performance: October 2026

Production: The total production of Passenger Vehicles1, Three Wheelers, Two Wheelers, and Quadricycle in October 2026 was 36,18,753 units

Domestic Sales:

  • Passenger Vehicles2 sales were 5,19,060 units in October 2026.
  • Three-wheeler sales were 1,03,349 units in October 2026
  • Two-wheeler sales were 25,77,810 units in October 2026.

 

1 BMW, Mercedes, JLR, Tata Motors & Volvo Auto data are not available.

2 BMW, Mercedes, JLR & Volvo Auto data are not available. Tata Motors Domestic Sales data included only in this document. However, without Tata Motors, ‘Total PV’ would be 4,45,166 units for October 2026

Commenting on October-2026 performance, Mr Rajesh Menon, Director General, SIAM said, “Indian automobile industry continues to witness healthy demand momentum. Passenger Vehicles recorded sales of 5.19 lakh units with a growth of 12.4%, while Two-Wheeler sales reached 25.78 lakh units, registering a growth of 16.1% compared to October 2025. Three-Wheeler sales stood at 1.03 lakh units, growing by 25.7% over the same period last year.

The Passenger Vehicle segment achieved its strongest-ever October performance, crossing the significant milestone of 5 lakh units in monthly sales. In the Two-Wheeler segment, demand continues to be supported by improved credit availability and replacement demand, across both rural and urban markets. For Three-Wheelers, last-mile mobility requirements and rapid electrification remain strong structural drivers. Overall, the demand outlook remains positive.”                                                                                      

Rajesh Menon, Director General, SIAM

rajesh.menon@siam.in
